properties.answer: Approved (Anthony, 2026-07-25). A design gets a UUID at genesis, stored in the graph and kept across opens and copies; the friendly name is a label on top. dec:identity-out-of-band accepted with it — identity is assigned with zero coordination, never derived from shared state.
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “A durable design knows its own name, and remembers it across opens”
properties.question: Should every design get a permanent name of its own the moment it is created — one it keeps forever, even if the folder is renamed or copied to another machine — with the friendly title just a label on top? Right now every design answers to the same built-in name, so two designs cannot tell each other apart, which is what makes linking one plan to another meaningless. The fleet's way of doing this is to use the identifier the system already handed out, so nobody has to coordinate to be unique.
